name: Ricotta Toast
steps: Toast four thick bread slices until golden and crisp.
Stir ricotta briefly until creamy; divide and spread thickly over the warm toast.
Wash and slice figs and berries. Arrange them evenly over the ricotta.
Drizzle each toast with maple syrup, scatter chopped pistachios and serve immediately.
tips: Use fresh ripe figs; substitute sliced pear when figs are unavailable.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
